about_the_game:
Choose an ancient deity to worship and use its power to defeat the unbelievers. Find Relics with eldritch abilities. Summon dreadful Defenders with unique traits, control the path by placing them, combine their Benedictions to and create otherworldly synergies!

SUMMON DEFENDERS

Offer souls to your god to draft three unique Defenders, each with a random Blessing. Choose one to summon.

UPGRADE DEFENDERS

Sacrifice a Defender to transfer one of its Blessings to the upgraded one.

SHAPE THE PATH

The path grows by one tile every wave, and every Defender you place influences in which direction it will grow next.

COLLECT RELICS OF OLD

Defeat Elite Enemies to reclaim Relics crafted by the old gods.

CREATE UNCANNY SYNERGIES

Some blessings and relics, when put together... break the game in beautiful ways.

[This clip is from a fairly older version, but it gives a very good idea of the stupid things that can be done so we're using it for now.] 

CHALLENGE EVOLVING BOSSES

Each map has a unique boss that will grow stronger every time you face them.

[Our boss still has placeholder visuals, we'll update the description with a new .gif as soon as it is done.]

  • Processor: Intel i3

  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
